'''Epsis''' was a predatory [[Bird/Legends|bird]] from [[Uba III]]. The epsis was a migratory [[Species/Legends|species]], moving alone or in mated pairs and never staying in one place for long. The epsis became extinct when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was destroyed.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
